issues.message: Owner sign-up step F08.S01 has no place and /sign-up cannot be reached from the frame or sign-in. Fix: Add a way to reach sign-up, such as a footer or sign-in choice "Create studio owner account" which goes to /sign-up, and give S08 a matching "Create account" choice to /sign-up, covering F08.S01.

The account editing alternative repeats the Edit action while already editing. Fix: Remove "Can choose Edit" from the "when editing" alternative so viewing shows Edit once and editing shows only the password field and Done.

The newest-first discount list shows expiry date but not the record date. Fix: Show each discount code's creation date in its table row in addition to expiry date, since the list is sorted newest first.
